title: Password Reset via Known Security Answer - Bjoern's Account
description: The password reset endpoint allows resetting any user's password if the security question answer is known. For the user bjoern@owasp.org, the answer 'Zaya' (OSINT from OWASP bio) successfully resets the password, demonstrating that password reset with known security answer is possible due to a weak/guessable answer.
